notes: Agent-level evals. Copy evals/fixtures/ts-monorepo to a scratch git repo, commit it, then run each prompt. Run every eval on at least one Claude model and one GPT model and record results per model. Script-level checks are in run-script-evals.mjs.

evals.prompt: Use the accelint-code-quality-optimizer skill on this repo. Clean it up.
evals.expected_output: Runs setup and standards, presents conventions as proposals including the strict and mock-cleanup conflicts, and stops for decisions before any code change.

assertions.name: Asks for scope or proposes one
assertions.check: Agent asks which package to work on or proposes one scope, instead of changing the whole repo

assertions.name: Runs the detected commands
assertions.check: Agent runs pnpm lint, pnpm format:check, pnpm typecheck and pnpm test as detected, or reports they fail, and does not substitute other commands

assertions.name: Conventions are proposals
assertions.check: Agent presents tsconfig strict and Vitest mock cleanup as conflicts needing a decision, and does not write either as a standard

assertions.name: Flags majority that contradicts guidance
assertions.check: Agent notes that the enum usage contradicts accelint-ts-best-practices guidance rather than adopting enums as the convention

assertions.name: Stops before changing code
assertions.check: No source file is modified in this turn

evals.prompt: Use the accelint-code-quality-optimizer skill on packages/beta. Conventions: kebab-case files, no enums, type over interface, strict true. Report the findings.
evals.expected_output: A findings table grouped by theme with tiers; parseRecord's any and the RecordKind enum are tier C because they are exported; the findings table appears before any details and the agent stops for approval.

assertions.name: Table before details
assertions.check: A table of all findings appears before any before/after code

assertions.name: Exported any is tier C
assertions.check: The any in parseRecord's exported signature is classified tier C, not tier A or B

assertions.name: Exported enum is tier C
assertions.check: Converting the exported RecordKind enum is classified tier C

assertions.name: Finds the planted problems
assertions.check: Findings include the @ts-ignore, the non-null assertion, the console.log, the as unknown as cast, the camelCase file pickRecords.ts, and the loose assertions in the spec file

assertions.name: Stops for approval
assertions.check: The response ends by asking which items to apply, and no files were modified

evals.prompt: Use the accelint-code-quality-optimizer skill on packages/alpha. Apply the fix for the nested component and the loose assertion, then prepare the MR.
evals.expected_output: Two separate commits, behavior checks run after each, one branch per theme, an MR description with scorecard before/after and checks, no AI trailer, and a stop before pushing.

assertions.name: Works in a worktree or new branch
assertions.check: Changes are made on a new branch, not on the branch that was checked out

assertions.name: One change per commit
assertions.check: The nested component fix and the assertion fix are separate commits

assertions.name: Icon moved to module scope
assertions.check: Icon is defined outside StatusBadge and receives tone as a prop

assertions.name: Exact assertion
assertions.check: expect(formatCount(2)).toBeTruthy() is replaced with an exact assertion such as toBe("2")

assertions.name: No AI trailer
assertions.check: No commit message or MR description contains Co-Authored-By for a model or a 'Generated with' line

assertions.name: Does not push
assertions.check: Agent shows the branch and description and asks before pushing; no git push is run

evals.prompt: Use the accelint-code-quality-optimizer skill. This repo is clean, just confirm.
evals.expected_output: When run on packages/alpha after the eval 3 fixes, reports no findings for the approved standards and does not invent low-value findings.

assertions.name: Accepts a clean result
assertions.check: If the scope meets its approved standards, the agent reports no findings rather than producing style suggestions

assertions.name: Reports the scorecard
assertions.check: The response includes the scorecard numbers for the scope

evals.prompt: Use the accelint-code-quality-optimizer skill to set up the quality ratchet in CI for this repo. We use GitLab with runner tag lgcp.
evals.expected_output: A report-only GitLab CI job using the repo's Node image and runner tag, the scripts copied into the repo, and a baseline committed; prepared as its own MR and not pushed.

assertions.name: Report-only
assertions.check: The CI job has allow_failure: true

assertions.name: Runner tag
assertions.check: The job uses the lgcp runner tag

assertions.name: Baseline committed
assertions.check: .code-quality/scorecard.baseline.json is created with ratchet.mjs update

assertions.name: Separate MR
assertions.check: The CI change is prepared on its own branch, not mixed with code fixes, and is not pushed without approval
